brief: Mary Sumner was born in 1828, and in 1876 founded the Mothers’ Union in the parish of Alresford. She was inspired by a great vision concerning the Christian responsibilities of motherhood. Mary gathered together women, many young and inexperienced and from different social backgrounds, for weekly classes. During her lifetime Mary Sumner saw the organisation spread throughout Great Britain and overseas and become an important part of the Anglican Communion. She died in 1921.
